title: How HTTPS protects a request
goal: Recognize three protections in one connection.

points.heading: Encrypt
points.body: TLS encrypts data between the browser and server.

points.heading: Verify
points.body: A valid certificate helps the browser authenticate the server.

points.heading: Detect changes
points.body: Integrity checks detect data altered in transit.

exampleBody: Before sending payment data, the browser establishes a verified, encrypted connection.
limitation: A secure connection does not prove that a shop is honest.
